parsed.explanation: Combined regime imposes unremedied universal exposure: national birth-sex document rule and entry discrepancy refusal/fraud risk, plus state birth-sex facility ban in government buildings including airports/schools with criminal trespass. Custody adds conversion-therapy/hormone-removal, forced labour, beatings and sexual abuse reports, and the sole facility arrest involved 24h in a men's ward. Official threat-framing and failed remedies compound this. Mitigations—private businesses exempt, existing X passports valid to expiry, fraud never automatic, some orders enjoined—do not offset tier-1 exposures.

entry_documents.exposure: X markers stopped for new passports; discrepancy casts doubt, case refused for more evidence; suspected wilful misrepresentation may support lifetime fraud ineligibility. Passports confiscated/blocked, travellers stranded.
entry_documents.protection: Existing X passports valid until expiration; fraud requires four elements and is never automatic; civil-liberties suit pending.
entry_documents.interaction: Document mismatch at entry can become refusal, stranding, or a fraud investigation interacting with later facility/custody checks.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: National corrections adopts conversion-therapy model: short hair, hormones removed, psychiatric substitution; immigration custody reports forced labour, beatings, solitary, severe sexual abuse. Facility arrestee held 24h in men's ward.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Not documented as operating remedy for these custody practices; few orders enjoined nationally.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Trespass arrest or immigration detention leads to birth-sex placement and documented custody harm.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: State 2023 law bars identity-consistent restrooms/changing facilities in government-owned/leased buildings, schools, universities, parks, airports; refusal to depart after order can be criminal trespass up to 60 days. National order bars government-funded identity-consistent facilities.
federal_state_facilities.protection: State law excludes private businesses; some national orders blocked/enjoined.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Authority on site orders departure; refusal converts facility use into criminal exposure across travel, campuses and transport hubs.

care_services.exposure: State bans gender-affirming care for minors and adds adult barriers/bar on insurance, physician-only rule; national orders target minor care and school social transition. Emergency ward practice not documented.
care_services.protection: National judge permanently blocked some care bans in June 2024, but appellate status unresolved in dossier.
care_services.interaction: Adult care disruption and, for travelling minors, denial/prosecution risk for facilitating transition interact with school/facility rules.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: National framing calls trans athletes deceptive, lists 'radical gender ideology'/'radically pro-transgender' in extremism prioritisation, orders investigations/prosecutions. Poll shows majority support birth-sex documents.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: Hate crimes punishable nationally; several executive orders blocked or enjoined; courts sometimes check action.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Official threat framing legitimises facility enforcement, document scrutiny and custody practices despite court challenges.

minors_guardians.exposure: Minors barred from blockers/hormones/surgeries unless intersex; school pronoun/name facilitation targeted for criminal investigation; custody-modification laws tied to care; July 2024 birth-certificate closure and licence fraud rule affect resident families.
minors_guardians.protection: Some care provisions blocked in June 2024; appellate outcome not documented.
minors_guardians.interaction: Travelling parent/guardian with minor faces care denial, school-facility exclusion, and potential investigation if transition facilitated.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: Dossier reports 3.7 trans women murdered per 100k/year and 'Do Not Travel' label, but no general homicide background rate, so magnitude is uncertain. Advocacy advisories warn of safety risks.
street_violence_police_response.protection: National hate-crime statute covers gender identity; state hate-crime law does not; human-relations commission investigates employment/housing/public-accommodation claims for 55% local-protection population.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Thin state recourse weakens protection from street violence; police are also facility-trespass enforcers.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Passport litigation unresolved; facility statute dismissed on standing, never substantively tested, no later arrest documented; airport application, emergency wards and detention frequency not documented.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Legal-aid FAQ, local protections, and some court injunctions exist but no demonstrated remedy changing facility/document/custody rules.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Unresolved litigation leaves traveller exposed to currently operative rules rather than hypothetical relief.

anchor_checks.comparison: Similar or slightly higher: both have birth-sex public facilities, document checks, rejected complaints, no presentation offence, and emergency/custody placement concerns. This case adds national entry fraud risk and documented custody abuse, but private businesses are exempt and only one facility arrest is documented, keeping it near 0.35 rather than far below.

Lower: 0.45-A has a single government-building bathroom rule with polite public and one prosecuted assault. Here the same facility ban coexists with national passport/entry restrictions, custody conversion-therapy/hormone removal, forced-labour reports, and minor-care prosecution directives, so cumulative tier-1 exposures push below 0.45.

Much lower: 0.65-C has no enforced sex-conduct lever, accepted documents, traditional acceptance, and compensation via ordinary courts. This dossier has active document/facility enforcement, criminal trespass, official threat framing and custody harm, with no comparable operating remedy.

parsed.synthesis: The traveller encounters one combined system: birth-sex documents at entry can trigger refusal or fraud scrutiny, then birth-sex facilities in government buildings/airports with trespass on refusal, then birth-sex custody with documented severe harms. Attractions are private businesses exempt and courts enjoin some orders, but no remedy displaces the operative rules. For minors, care bans and school-transition prosecution add guardian exposure. This is unremedied universal exposure plus custody severity, above organised sweeps/imprisonment campaigns but well below reduced-risk tiers.
